## Summary

Landed the finished Slides work from `/tmp/slides-attempt1/` (`tracked.patch` applied cleanly; `new-files.tar` extracted). Ran `npm install` so `pptxgenjs` is in `node_modules`.

After merge with current `main`, `PrototypeInspector` expects `applyAlign` / `applyDistribute`. Wired those in `slide-board.tsx` using the same `alignElements` / `distributeElements` helpers as the prototype builder.

## Verification

- `npx tsc --noEmit` — pass  
- `node --experimental-strip-types --test …` — **101** tests, 0 failures  

## Changed paths

| Area | Paths |
|------|--------|
| Dependency | `package.json`, `package-lock.json` (`pptxgenjs`) |
| Server | `server.ts`, `src/server/slides.ts` (Slides/ save, list, load RPC) |
| Studio shell | `src/studio/studio-panel.tsx` (Slides card enabled), `src/studio/tools.tsx` (`SlidesTool` → `SlidesEditor`) |
| Slides feature | `src/studio/slides/` — `editor.tsx`, `slide-board.tsx`, `presenter.tsx`, `model.ts`, `layouts.ts`, `pptx-export.ts`, tests |
| i18n | `src/shared/i18n.ts` |

Slides tool: deck editor with prototype canvas/inspector, thumbnails (add/duplicate/delete/reorder), layout presets, presenter mode, thread `Slides/` storage, PNG/PPTX export, send to chat. Prototype and Paint launcher paths are unchanged aside from the shared inspector API fix in slides only.

dispatchContext.memoryText:
- Invariant: picking a tool and the Back to tools action in the launcher work as before. The Prototype and Paint tools (`src/studio/prototype/` and `src/studio/paint/`) are not changed by launcher work.
- The `button-outline` palette tile (outline variant) is defined in `src/studio/prototype/palette.ts` and creates the outline button. Its label comes from the i18n key `protoTileButtonOutline` in `src/shared/i18n.ts`; the ru labels are «Кнопка» (outline) and «Основная кнопка» (primary).
- `src/studio/prototype/icon-inspector.tsx`: selecting an `Icon` element in the prototype builder shows an inspector with a preview, a Change button that opens a dialog picker for the icon name, a size control (16 to 48), and a colour control (foreground, muted, primary, or a custom hex value).
dispatchContext.rulesText:
- Перед ответом по задаче Lane Pilot сверяй каждый путь, который собираешься изменить из-за ошибки проверки, с owns_paths; если пути там нет, не меняй файл и сообщи об ошибке диспетчеру.
- In the Pokecut theme never override the desktop sidebar panel's top (BB places it below the macOS chrome row); stretch it with bottom: 0; height: auto. Desktop sidebar markup has data-side on the outer group div, so target [data-side="left"] > [data-sidebar="panel"], not [data-sidebar="panel"][data-side="left"] (phone-only).
